units.source_text: 他全凭想象清晰地描绘出这种椰子的花的形状。

en.t: Relying entirely on his imagination, he clearly pictured the shape of this coconut flower.

units.source_text: 他的喉咙前所未有的痒，不由的在辞典上吐了口痰。

en.t: His throat itched as never before, and without meaning to, he spat a mouthful of phlegm onto the dictionary.
Phlegm? No, that was not phlegm either.

units.source_text: 他想到短暂的生命，又想到着椰子花——在遥远的大海彼岸高高耸立的椰子花。

en.t: He thought of his brief life, and then of the coconut flower, the coconut flower towering high on the far side of the vast sea.
